display_long_description:
Become the city's own hero.

SpiderMonk puts you in the body of a web-slinging monkey in a city that never ends. Move the way you'd expect a monkey to: push off the ground and walls with your arms to run, jump and climb. Then fire a web and swing between skyscrapers at full speed.

SWING LIKE YOU MEAN IT
Fire webs from either hand, reel in, let go at the top of the arc and fly. Spread your arms to glide, zip up a web, crawl up walls, and slam into the street for a superhero landing.

FIGHT CRIME
Gangs are robbing the streets. Punch, dodge and counter with your own hands, wrap thugs up in webs, and clean up the city one crime at a time.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Join a public room or make a private one with a code, then pick a game mode:
• Casual: swing, explore and hang out
• Venom Tag: one touch or one web and you're infected; the last one clean wins
• PvP: fight your friends; first to 5 knockouts wins
• Coin Rush: 3 minutes to grab the most coins
• Floor Is Lava: the streets are burning; touch them and lose a life

MAKE IT YOURS
Collect coins across the city and spend them on suits, hats, face items, badges and web colours. Try them on in your apartment mirror.

COMFORT OPTIONS
Snap turn, a comfort vignette, swing assist and a menu you can place wherever you like.

Online play requires an internet connection.
